name.description: Base64-encoded client name for the Art Mode channel

token.description: Previously approved token to bypass on-TV approval prompt

ArtMode.description: Samsung Art Mode (Frame TV) channel for artwork management, brightness control, and Art Mode on/off. Uses double-encoded JSON in the `data` field of `ms.channel.emit` messages.

name.description: Base64-encoded client name used by Samsung remote channel

token.description: Previously approved remote token to bypass repeated on-TV prompts

RemoteControl.description: Samsung remote control channel for key transport and lifecycle events. First connection may trigger an on-TV approval prompt; approved sessions provide a token for subsequent reconnects.

ArtMode.ArtModeCommand.description: Art Mode command sent via `ms.channel.emit` with double-encoded data payload. Supports brightness, artwork selection, and mode control.
ArtMode.ArtModeCommand.name: ArtModeCommand

ArtMode.ArtModeEvent.description: Art Mode response event. The `data` field contains a double-encoded JSON string that must be parsed separately.
ArtMode.ArtModeEvent.name: ArtModeEvent

ArtMode.ChannelConnectEvent.description: Emitted when the Art Mode channel is successfully connected.
ArtMode.ChannelConnectEvent.name: ChannelConnectEvent

ArtMode.ChannelEnvelope.description: Generic envelope with deferred payload for any other Art Mode event.
ArtMode.ChannelEnvelope.name: ChannelEnvelope

RemoteControl.AppLaunchCommand.description: Launch an application via `ms.channel.emit` with optional deep-link metadata. Supports both `DEEP_LINK` and `NATIVE_LAUNCH` action types.
RemoteControl.AppLaunchCommand.name: AppLaunchCommand

RemoteControl.ChannelConnectEvent.description: Emitted when the channel is successfully connected and authorized. May include a `token` for future reconnects.
RemoteControl.ChannelConnectEvent.name: ChannelConnectEvent

RemoteControl.ChannelEnvelope.description: Generic envelope with deferred `RawValue` payload for any other event. Route by inspecting `event` or `method`, then deserialize `data` on demand.
RemoteControl.ChannelEnvelope.name: ChannelEnvelope

RemoteControl.ChannelUnauthorizedEvent.description: Emitted when channel connection is unauthorized (approval needed or denied).
RemoteControl.ChannelUnauthorizedEvent.name: ChannelUnauthorizedEvent

RemoteControl.InstalledAppsCommand.description: Request the list of installed applications via `ms.channel.emit`. The TV responds with an `ed.installedApp.get` event containing the app list.
RemoteControl.InstalledAppsCommand.name: InstalledAppsCommand

RemoteControl.RemoteControlCommand.description: Remote key command (method, key, action). Use `Cmd=Click` for single presses, `Press`/`Release` for hold gestures.
RemoteControl.RemoteControlCommand.name: RemoteControlCommand

SamsungAppLaunchCommand.description: Payload type `SamsungAppLaunchCommand`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungArtModeCommand.description: Payload type `SamsungArtModeCommand`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungArtModeEvent.description: Payload type `SamsungArtModeEvent`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungInstalledAppsCommand.description: Payload type `SamsungInstalledAppsCommand`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungRemoteConnectEvent.description: Payload type `SamsungRemoteConnectEvent`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungRemoteControlCommand.description: Payload type `SamsungRemoteControlCommand`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungRemoteEnvelope.description: Payload type `SamsungRemoteEnvelope`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungRemoteErrorEvent.description: Payload type `SamsungRemoteErrorEvent`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.

SamsungRemoteUnauthorizedEvent.description: Payload type `SamsungRemoteUnauthorizedEvent`. Schematic WebSocket definitions declare no JSON Schema for payloads, so any JSON value is accepted.
